text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I just haven't been feeling like myself.
I have to do something before it starts affecting my work.
While fretting over it...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Hey, hey, you over there~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you there! Haven't you been feeling out of sorts lately?
That's because your qi is blocked—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Look, Rickey.
You're putting her on the spot by springing that on her so suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Unlike Rickey with her feng shui hobby,
not everyone believes in lucky charms and superstition, you know.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No way! Feng shui isn't just superstitious mumbo-jumbo~!
Proof is better than theory! Let me show you☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tell me whatever troubles you want solved! I'll fix 'em right up with feng shui☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her sheer intensity creates an aura
where one has no choice but to answer...
choice_data_list: I want to speed up my work.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Then your lucky color is blue!
I'm sure it'll give you a hand☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Following Copano Rickey's advice, I changed my computer wallpaper to a photo of a blue sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
........
Looking at this blue that threatens to swallow me whole, my mind begins to settle.
choice_data_list: ...Alright, let's take care of them one by one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to the change of pace, that day's work
went far smoother than usual!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see, problem solved with flying colors!
Yay~☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Blue stimulates the parasympathetic nervous system and calms the mind.
Keeping a cool head during work boosts efficiency too!
See? It makes total sense, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tarumae!
Feng shui is classified as an environmental and statistical science, you know.
Next time, I'll teach Tarumae too――

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
N—No way!
I have my own way of doing things.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Then try working some red into your accessories☆
Red is a color that sparks pure power!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Following Copano Rickey's advice, I made sure to start carrying a red handkerchief with me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought it might be too flashy... but that's exactly why
looking at it lifted my spirits and filled me with energy!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's give it our all today too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh, uh-huh. Looking at the Five Elements and Nine Star Ki,
I knew your target color was red.
choice_data_list: Five Elements theory? Nine Star astrology?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, think of it as the criteria
we use when assessing the balance of qi.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui evaluates and analyzes what's necessary based
on a comprehensive look at various factors.
That's just like any regular academic field, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tarumae!
Feng shui is actually a science related to environmental studies and statistics.
Next time, I'll show Tarumae too――

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
N-No way!
I have my own way of doing things, you know.
